annotations.text:
Two constructions for the decentralized.* family monogram — one device across .cloud, .exchange and .trade, with a per-sibling cue.

Each is shown as the family base, three derivations, both lockups, true 16/24/32px renders, a tile, a flat-token form, one ink, and a dark ground. Each states its construction, what it is not, and its own cost.

The product routes cloud compute jobs and prices them with evidence: every quote carries the source that produced it, when it was observed, and when it stops being true.
